taxonomy_notes: POWO accepts Ginkgo biloba; sole extant Ginkgo species. Its fleshy-coated seeds are naked gymnosperm seeds, not botanical fruits.
look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Single fan-shaped leaves with repeatedly FORKING (dichotomous) veins, often notched at tip; leaves cluster on short spur shoots. Female trees bear fleshy-coated naked seeds, not berries or drupes.

project_inclusion.notes: Approved source-pool learner admission; native outside North America per POWO, not a target-county native PASS. Do not infer invasive status.
project_inclusion.source_pool: Master Plant Pool row 511; installer preflight mass-04
project_inclusion.range_basis: POWO: native southeastern China; no Texas-native PASS.

morphology_keys.habit: Deciduous ornamental tree, crown narrow to spreading with age.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Simple fan-shaped long-petioled leaves with dichotomously forked veins; notch variable; short spur shoots often carry clusters.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Gymnosperm: male pollen cones and female stalked ovules; no true flowers.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Fleshy-coated seeds borne on female trees, not enclosed in a fruit ovary.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Short spur shoots plus longer extension shoots; rough furrowed bark with age.

confused_with: Adiantum spp.: multiple fan-shaped pinnules on fern fronds, not tree leaves.
Liriodendron tulipifera: notched lobed leaves with netted veins, not forked ginkgo venation.
Cercis canadensis: heart-shaped leaves with netted veins.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Woody tree with fan-shaped leaves and dichotomous venation; do not rely on yellow fall color.
